title: Insert silence
summary: Insert digital silence into the output at a point of the original recording; the output becomes longer. Nothing is invented. Applied to the result, just before the final limiter.

params.title: At
params.help: Where to insert, in seconds of the original recording: 0 is the start, the recording's length is the end.

params.title: Fades
params.help: The audio fades out before the silence and back in after it, so neither edge clicks. 0 leaves the edges hard.
